regions.merged_text: Feb. 5th - 10:30 pm - Before postponements How wonderful is the Lord in all His ways! How can we ever appreciate - be gratiful !!! I enjoyed your letter. . . . Not that this or that person was directly concerned, but it would be a happy theme if one had time a ability to go into details of such a privilege and such a manifestation of God's mercy and generous condescention to any - to us - poor sinners. Thanks be to God for all His hidden designs - as well as for those we praise as manifestations. Fr. Guardian just came across the corridor (almost expected a reminder to retire) to tell me we would have the High Mass on Friday for you and your intentions - the first of five for your Int. - besides Enrollments
